preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of roads m must be positive and cannot exceed the maximum possible number of roads in a complete graph of n cities.
Bash's city s must be a valid city index within the range of 1 to n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two distinct valid cities and have a positive length.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum number of friends who can be made unhappy by destroying exactly one city.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"2 <= n <= 200000","description":"The number of cities n must be between 2 and 200,000."},{"id":"P2","expression":"m > 0 and m <= n * (n - 1) // 2","description":"The number of roads m must be positive and cannot exceed the maximum possible number of roads in a complete graph of n cities."},{"id":"P3","expression":"1 <= s <= n","description":"Bash's city s must be a valid city index within the range of 1 to n."},{"id":"P4","expression":"all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v and 1 <= w <= 10**9 for u, v, w in roads)","description":"Each road must connect two distinct valid cities and have a positive length."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == str(max_unhappy_friends)","description":"The output must be the maximum number of friends who can be made unhappy by destroying exactly one city."}],"invariants":[]}
